posts.title_en: crumb.gg public JSON: S5 conquest scores joined with account power and season history
posts.summary_en: Raw captures are in 16-top-players/09–16. crumb.gg's public leaderboard gives each top conquest player's total account power (cp) and level. The S5 top 20 are all Lv.188–190 with 17–26G total power, and S5 score ÷ total power is roughly 95–143×. Season history shows steady growth, e.g. 날씨의아이 S1 208G, S2 477G, S3 1.11T, S4 1.79T, S5 3.23T. The S4 leaders were about 1.8T, which matches the forum's 1.3–1.6T ceiling, so the S5 jump is recent. Conquest teams are not exposed; the lookup API returns cp, rank and arena rating only.
mechanics: S5 window per API: start 1790233200000, end 1790564400000 (ms epoch), weekly. Guild raid_score for 카페 = 60,797G across 30 members (≈2T average).

posts.title_en: crumb.gg Rumble Arena teams of the same top players (ARENA mode, not conquest)
posts.summary_en: Many S5 conquest leaders also rank in Rumble Arena (날씨의아이 #2, 검은반장 #5, 현이 #8, 타미 #14, 아나 #15). Their arena teams are public: nearly all run Macaron, Pinot Noir, Cheesecake, Pomegranate, Milk (Crunchy Strong Pediatrician) plus Nameless Cake Hound, Ion, Moon Rabbit, Oven Wanderer, Bari, Cherry Cola or Herb. Pets are almost always Hot Doggie, Holy Baby Drop (ATK +20%) and Majestic King Choco Drop (HP +20%). This is arena, not conquest, so it shows what they own and build, not their conquest lineup.

The result screen shows a final score of 1,999,420,771,386 (1T 999G) with guild rank 1st. The author says it was the Cherry deck at about 650× team power, with all move speed removed. Milk's ATK is 1.27M from six SSR ATK lines, all minimum rolls. They cleared 차원의 이면, but it gave no spec for conquest.

posts.title_en: Tried whether you can survive past 17 s
posts.summary_en: The in-battle stat screen shows Bright Seeker (TSSR) at HP 9M 404K, ATK 1M 418K, DEF 364K, crit rate 202.10%, crit dmg 211.44%, crit res 119.03%, DR 45.64% and move speed 3.5. The Seeker reliably survives the 17 s wipe to about 9 s, while Dark Choco and the ATK-tuned cookies (~5M HP) do not. The author used the 왕방울 and 얼음새 pets for the test, plus Hot Dog on the front line. A commenter says 카페 (the #1 guild) earlier published a video near 1T that did NOT survive 17 s, and speculates their later growth comes from dealers surviving 17 s for extra poison and drone damage.

unorthodox: HP/DR pets instead of damage pets to survive 17 s

mechanics: Seeker with 9.4M HP / 45.6% DR survives the 17 s super-jump; 5M-HP ATK-order cookies cannot.

posts.title_en: Hit 1.3T about five times — is that my ceiling?
posts.summary_en: The author has 3G team power (~450×) and keeps getting 1.3T. Replies: at 2.6G one player got 1.5T; 600× should be normal; one went to 780× after more retries. Skill amp 6 lines plus skill haste 6 lines is expected. On the top-left gear piece, higher skill amp beats crit, and whether to take crit rate or crit dmg depends on crit rate after Macaron's buff (30 or more: crit rate, below: crit dmg).
